text: Onon ɓiɓɓe Isra'il - Annabi Yaakub -ciwtoree mojjereeji Alla ɗi O waɗani on njetton Mo, njokkon humnude aadi Am e mon, goonɗinde Mi e nulaaɓe Am, e gollirde sariyaaji Am ɗi, so on kumnii aadi Am e ko podan-Mi on ko, wano nguurndam mbelɗam e aduna, e njoɓdi moƴƴiri ñande darnga, kulon Mi Miin tan tawa on pirtataa aadi Am o.
